programme.desc: For the very first time, it's caramel week! The remaining bakers face three sticky challenges, including a super sweet signature and a double-Dutch technical. S8, Ep4

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel treats his friends and family to an irresistible red rice salad with merguez sausages. Plus, he prepares a bavette steak with grilled vegetables. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Sense Of Adventure. Nigel proves that adventurous cooking doesn't have to be complicated. He uses unusual ingredients like squid and rabbit to create delectable dishes. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Planning Ahead. Nigel shows how, with a little forward planning, cooking can be stress free. He uses a variety of methods to cut cooking time down massively. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Not-Your-Everyday, All Day. Guy Fieri digs into not-your-everyday dishes, including a stacked-up breakfast in New Mexico and creative vegan cooking in San Diego. S36, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Culinary Adventure. Guy Fieri jumps into a full culinary adventure. In San Diego there's a spot serving Baja-style tacos and a funky food truck putting' out next-level shawarma. S36, Ep7
